//: NO SECRETS IN THIS FILE. Connection strings and the OIDC client secret arrive from the environment or the platform secret store: ConnectionStrings__ExpertHub, Oidc__ClientSecret. A test asserts the keys below stay empty.
//access: TrainerFastRoles: the values that mean 'trainer' in the Academy's record. Someone whose profile carries one is granted the trainer role at sign-in. EMPTY GRANTS NOTHING — see FastTrainerGrant.
//documents: Where uploaded documents are written. Empty = the platform database. Set Documents__RootPath to a MOUNTED VOLUME in a container, or every upload is lost on the next deployment.
//teams: Interview meetings (J-06/F2). Empty ClientSecret = the provider is off and no meeting is ever booked. Calendars.ReadWrite (Application) MUST be scoped to the organiser mailbox with an Exchange New-ApplicationAccessPolicy, or the app can read and write every calendar in the tenant.
//fast: INT-05. Empty BaseUrl = the client is off and every call fails closed. Every FAST endpoint is scoped to the authenticated user, so a token provider must be chosen before this does anything — see IFastTokenProvider.
